readings.commitment: Birth on the territory is the rule entire: 'subject to the jurisdiction' excludes only diplomats and invading armies, and every other child born here is born a citizen
readings.delta: Suppression of parentage-based gatekeeping; beneficiary is children of all residents including the undocumented; victim set is consent-based membership theory; extractiveness of hereditary outsider status forbidden at birth

readings.commitment: Jurisdiction means allegiance: the clause requires more than geography, and children of those owing allegiance elsewhere fall outside its grant
readings.delta: Suppression of pure territorialism; beneficiary is membership-by-consent doctrine; victim set is birthright claims of the temporarily present; extractiveness of citizenship conditioned on political tie

readings.commitment: Wong Kim Ark settled it in 1898: the common-law territorial rule survived into the clause, and a century of reliance has built on that settlement
readings.delta: Suppression of reopening by precedential weight; beneficiary is settled-expectation holders; victim set is revisionist readings; extractiveness of destabilized status barred by stare decisis

readings.commitment: Incorporation proceeded right by right: each guarantee tested for fundamentality and absorbed one case at a time, until nearly all came through
readings.delta: Suppression of state exemption piecemeal; beneficiary is rights-holders as each right lands; victim set is state procedural diversity; extractiveness checked guarantee by guarantee

readings.commitment: Justice Black had the honest rule: the Fourteenth incorporated the whole Bill at ratification, and selectivity is judges choosing which rights they like
readings.delta: Suppression of judicial selectivity; beneficiary is textual completeness; victim set is fundamental-fairness discretion; extractiveness of partial protection rejected wholesale

readings.commitment: Bolling ran the doctrine backward: equal protection bound the federal government through Fifth Amendment due process, because segregated D.C. schools could not stand while Brown fell on the states
readings.delta: Suppression of the federal gap in equality law; beneficiary is claimants against federal discrimination; victim set is text-bound symmetry objections; extractiveness of federal caste barred by implication

readings.commitment: The doctrine's first life was economic: liberty of contract striking down hours and wages laws, the era whose name became the standing accusation against the whole enterprise
readings.delta: Suppression of social legislation in the name of contract; beneficiary is employers and laissez-faire doctrine; victim set is protective labor law; extractiveness of bargaining inequality constitutionalized

readings.commitment: The doctrine's second life is intimate: contraception, marriage, child-rearing — a private sphere the state may not enter without compelling cause
readings.delta: Suppression of moral regulation of intimacy; beneficiary is the household's decisional privacy; victim set is majoritarian morals legislation; extractiveness of intimate governance fenced out

readings.commitment: Glucksberg disciplines the doctrine: only rights deeply rooted in history and tradition qualify, careful description required — the brake the Court applies and releases by turns
readings.delta: Suppression of novel rights claims at the threshold; beneficiary is judicial-restraint doctrine; victim set is emerging liberty claims; extractiveness of recognition rationed by the historical record

readings.commitment: Mathews made process arithmetic: private interest, error risk, and government burden weighed to size the hearing — due process as an optimization, not a fixed form
readings.delta: Suppression of one-size procedure; beneficiary is administrative flexibility; victim set is categorical-hearing claimants; extractiveness of process budgeted to the stakes

readings.commitment: Goldberg made welfare a stake worth process: benefits terminable only after a hearing, the brutal need of the recipient outweighing fiscal convenience
readings.delta: Suppression of summary termination; beneficiary is benefit recipients facing cutoff; victim set is administrative speed; extractiveness of subsistence conditioned on prior hearing

readings.commitment: Reich's new property won: licenses, benefits, and public employment are property for process purposes, because government largesse is the modern estate
readings.delta: Suppression of the rights-privilege distinction; beneficiary is holders of statutory entitlements; victim set is at-will government discretion; extractiveness of dependence on the state given procedural armor

readings.commitment: Reed sharpened the trigger: a law is content-based if it draws lines by topic or message on its face, whatever its purpose — and then strict scrutiny does its work
readings.delta: Suppression of benign-purpose escape routes; beneficiary is speakers under topic-drawn rules; victim set is regulatory drafting convenience; extractiveness of message-sorting laws presumptively barred

readings.commitment: Secondary effects soften the rule: zoning adult businesses for crime and blight is 'content neutral' though the category is content-defined — the doctrine's acknowledged fiction
readings.delta: Suppression relaxed where effects can be named; beneficiary is municipal regulation; victim set is the trigger's coherence; extractiveness of disfavored speech zoned under another name

readings.commitment: Neutrality's mirror is compulsion: the state can no more require the flag salute or the motto than forbid them — the right not to speak as the doctrine's other half
readings.delta: Suppression of mandated orthodoxy; beneficiary is objectors to required affirmation; victim set is civic-compulsion programs; extractiveness of professed belief unextractable

readings.commitment: Brandenburg fixed incitement's border: only advocacy directed to imminent lawless action and likely to produce it loses protection — abstract advocacy of violence is speech
readings.delta: Suppression confined to the imminent; beneficiary is radical advocacy short of the line; victim set is bad-tendency prosecution; extractiveness of dissent by dangerousness-talk forbidden

readings.commitment: Miller keeps obscenity outside: prurient appeal, patent offensiveness, and no serious value, judged by community standards — a category surviving on a three-part definition nobody loves
readings.delta: Suppression of the defined category only; beneficiary is community-standards regulation; victim set is borderline expression and its distributors; extractiveness of the category policed by jury geography

readings.commitment: Stevens closed the list: no fresh categories by cost-benefit balancing — violent games and animal-cruelty depictions stay protected because history, not harm arithmetic, defines the exceptions
readings.delta: Suppression of category invention; beneficiary is novel disturbing expression; victim set is harm-based carve-out proposals; extractiveness of new exceptions barred at the threshold

readings.commitment: Streets and parks are held in trust: immemorially used for assembly and debate, they carry the strongest speech protection government property can bear
readings.delta: Suppression of closure of the commons; beneficiary is street-level speakers and marches; victim set is municipal control of public space; extractiveness of access to the traditional commons guaranteed

readings.commitment: Government can open forums it didn't have to: meeting rooms and funds once opened must be viewpoint-neutral — the choice is whether to open, never whom to favor
readings.delta: Suppression of selective generosity; beneficiary is disfavored groups seeking opened space; victim set is curating administrators; extractiveness of access rationed only by neutral terms

readings.commitment: The government is also a speaker: monuments, license-plate designs, and programs carry its own message, exempt from forum neutrality — the doctrine's growing exception
readings.delta: Suppression of forum claims against state expression; beneficiary is governmental message control; victim set is access claimants to state channels; extractiveness of the public megaphone reserved where speech is the state's own

readings.commitment: Heller fixed the core: handguns in the home for self-defense, the right's center of gravity, with longstanding regulations presumptively untouched
readings.delta: Suppression of home-handgun bans; beneficiary is armed householders; victim set is categorical prohibition regimes; extractiveness of the core protected, the periphery reserved

readings.commitment: Bruen changed the method: no interest balancing — modern regulation stands only with a historical analogue from the founding era's regulatory tradition
readings.delta: Suppression of tiered scrutiny in this domain; beneficiary is challengers armed with history; victim set is novel regulatory responses to novel weapons; extractiveness of gun regulation conditioned on 1791's imagination

readings.commitment: The right has a geography: schools, courthouses, and polling places stand outside it, and the fight has moved to how far 'sensitive places' can stretch
readings.delta: Suppression of carry in designated zones; beneficiary is location-based regulation; victim set is carry-everywhere claims; extractiveness of the right metered by map

readings.commitment: The warrant rule lives through exclusion: evidence from unconstitutional search suppressed, the only remedy that ever made the Amendment self-enforcing
readings.delta: Suppression of the violation's fruits; beneficiary is defendants and deterred policing; victim set is probative evidence and its users; extractiveness of shortcuts priced at the suppression hearing

readings.commitment: Leon hollowed exclusion where deterrence fails: officers reasonably relying on a warrant keep the evidence, because suppression punishes no one worth deterring
readings.delta: Suppression of the remedy where fault is absent; beneficiary is reliant officers and prosecutions; victim set is the rule's categorical bite; extractiveness of error tolerated when honest

readings.commitment: Carpenter dragged the doctrine into the cloud: cell-site location history needs a warrant despite the third-party rule — digital aggregation as a difference in kind
readings.delta: Suppression of warrantless digital dragnets; beneficiary is the location-tracked public; victim set is third-party-doctrine maximalism; extractiveness of pervasive records gated by the magistrate

readings.commitment: Evolution's main work is capital: the intellectually disabled, juveniles, and non-homicide crimes carved out one consensus at a time — the penalty narrowed toward its core
readings.delta: Suppression of execution category by category; beneficiary is the exempted classes; victim set is maximal capital statutes; extractiveness of death rationed by counted consensus

readings.commitment: Miller and Graham made youth constitutional: diminished culpability and capacity for change bar mandatory life without parole for juveniles — development science read into the Clause
readings.delta: Suppression of irrevocable juvenile sentences; beneficiary is youthful offenders' future selves; victim set is mandatory-sentencing schemes; extractiveness of a life foreclosed at fifteen forbidden

readings.commitment: The Clause follows the prisoner inside: deliberate indifference to medical need or violence violates it — punishment includes the conditions, not just the sentence
readings.delta: Suppression of warehouse indifference; beneficiary is the incarcerated; victim set is unaccountable prison administration; extractiveness of confinement bounded by minimal humanity

readings.commitment: The Amendment exists to bury Pollock: the Court had killed the income tax by apportionment, and the people overruled the Court by Article V
readings.delta: Suppression of the apportionment shield; beneficiary is progressive taxation's constitutional basis; victim set is the Pollock settlement's protected wealth; extractiveness of income reachable without state-by-state math

readings.commitment: Macomber planted realization in the text: income means gain realized, not paper appreciation — the doctrine that still guards unrealized wealth from the Amendment's reach
readings.delta: Suppression of accrual taxation claims; beneficiary is holders of appreciating unsold assets; victim set is mark-to-market designs; extractiveness of wealth taxed only at the sale

readings.commitment: The open question is wealth itself: is a net-worth tax a direct tax requiring apportionment, or did the Amendment's logic free it — Moore left the door ajar
readings.delta: Suppression unresolved at the doctrine's edge; beneficiary is whichever side the answer favors; victim set is legislative certainty; extractiveness of fortunes pending a case not yet brought

readings.commitment: Prohibition failed at enforcement: Volstead's reach exceeded any budget, juries nullified, and the law's gap taught contempt for law itself
readings.delta: Suppression unenforceable at the scale declared; beneficiary is the illicit market; victim set is legal-order credibility; extractiveness of compliance unobtainable at any appropriated price

readings.commitment: Prohibition capitalized the mob: a national market handed to criminal organization, whose profits outlived the Amendment that created them
readings.delta: Suppression of the trade transferred, not ended; beneficiary is the syndicates; victim set is cities under their wars; extractiveness rerouted through violence and graft

readings.commitment: Prohibition is the cautionary precedent: social regulation does not belong in constitutional text, the lesson cited against every later proposal to constitutionalize a policy
readings.delta: Suppression of policy-in-the-constitution proposals ever after; beneficiary is amendment minimalism; victim set is morals-amendment movements; extractiveness of the lesson paid once, cited forever

readings.commitment: The two-term limit is anti-Caesarism in text: the Washington norm restored as law after Roosevelt proved norms break — rotation entrenched against the popular strongman
readings.delta: Suppression of indefinite incumbency; beneficiary is rotation and challengers; victim set is successful presidents and their movements; extractiveness of accumulated executive power capped at eight years

readings.commitment: The limit lames every second term: a president who cannot run again loses leverage the day after re-election — accountability to voters traded away with the eligibility
readings.delta: Suppression of the re-election incentive; beneficiary is congressional leverage late-term; victim set is second-term agendas; extractiveness of electoral discipline removed exactly when power peaks

readings.commitment: The limit overrules the voters by category: whoever the people might want a third time is forbidden in advance — term limits as distrust of the demos written into the document
readings.delta: Suppression of an electoral option permanently; beneficiary is precommitment constitutionalism; victim set is voter choice at its widest; extractiveness of the option removed from every future ballot

readings.commitment: The Articles died of Article XIII: amendment by unanimity let Rhode Island veto the union — a rule that made reform impossible and revolution the only amendment procedure
readings.delta: Suppression of adaptation by impossible threshold; beneficiary is any single holdout; victim set is the confederation's viability; extractiveness of the status quo absolute until the system was abandoned

readings.commitment: The Articles ran on requisitions states ignored: Congress could ask but never tax, and the war debt sat unpaid while the system politely starved
readings.delta: Suppression of central coercion total; beneficiary is non-paying states free-riding; victim set is creditors and the army; extractiveness of revenue voluntary and therefore absent

readings.commitment: Article II was the point: each state retains its sovereignty, freedom, and independence — the Articles weren't a failed nation but a successful league, judged by the wrong standard
readings.delta: Suppression of national consolidation by design; beneficiary is state self-rule; victim set is nation-building measures; extractiveness of central power refused on principle, not by accident
